task.description: Build REQ-003 per docs/agents/design/REQ-003.md (gated PASS by CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR). Verify branch: git branch --show-current must equal feature/WF02-REQ003-REQ004 first — STOP and report FAIL if not. Implement exactly per the design: (1) append 'en' to the locales array in src/i18n/routing.ts, keep defaultLocale 'ru'; (2) create messages/en.json with the same structure/key-set as messages/ru.json, every value duplicated verbatim from ru.json as a placeholder, except Metadata.ogLocale which should be 'en_US' (per the design gate's resolution of that open question, analogous to ru_RU/uz_UZ); (3) do NOT modify src/i18n/request.ts, src/components/landing/LocaleSwitcher.tsx, or src/app/[locale]/layout.tsx — the design and its gate both independently verified these need no change for a third locale; if your own build-time testing finds otherwise, STOP and report the discrepancy rather than silently patching around it.
acceptance_criteria: src/i18n/routing.ts's locales array is exactly ["ru", "uz", "en"], defaultLocale remains "ru"

messages/en.json exists with identical key structure to messages/ru.json (177 leaf keys, same nesting), every value non-empty; Metadata.ogLocale is "en_US"; all other values are the ru.json value duplicated verbatim
Visiting /en (via npm run build && npm run start) renders <html lang="en">, and /ru and /uz still render correctly (no regression)
LocaleSwitcher.tsx renders three options and EN navigates correctly to/from /en/* — verify manually since no automated test framework exists yet

Self-review checklist per frontend_developer_guide.md §4 completed (no raw hex colors, no new spacing, icon rules, light/dark theme, mobile/desktop, copy casing) — though this change touches no visual code, state that explicitly rather than skipping the checklist silently

result.summary: Implemented REQ-003 per docs/agents/design/REQ-003.md: appended 'en' to routing.ts's locales array (defaultLocale unchanged at 'ru'); created messages/en.json programmatically from ru.json (177/177 leaf keys match, verified by script), with every value duplicated verbatim except Metadata.ogLocale = 'en_US' per the design's exception. request.ts, LocaleSwitcher.tsx, and layout.tsx were not touched — confirmed by build-time testing that they need no change (generic over routing.locales, as the design predicted). npm run lint: 0 errors, 4 pre-existing warnings unrelated to this change (Avatar.jsx, Footer.tsx, Nav.tsx usage, none in touched files). npm run build: succeeded. Manual verification via npm run build && npm run start: /en returns 200 and renders ; /ru and /uz still render lang="ru"/lang="uz" and return 200 (no regression); LocaleSwitcher renders three links (RU/UZ/EN) with correct active state and hrefs on all three locale pages, and the RU/UZ targets resolve. Self-review checklist completed; this change touches no visual/CSS/component code so the token/spacing/icon/theme/viewport items are explicitly N/A rather than silently skipped.
